items.title: New Research Reveals Link Between Gum Health, Tooth Loss, and Weight Gain in Older Adults
items.summary: CHICAGO – April 8, 2026 — Losing teeth may do more than change a smile – it may also affect your weight. A new study published in the Journal of Periodontology highlights a compelling connection between poor gum health, tooth loss, and weight gain in older adults, adding to growing evidence that periodontal health plays a critical role in overall health as we age.
